title: Chapter 6924: Please Show Mercy

Chapter 6924: Please Show Mercy

Chapter 6924: Please Show Mercy

Although the words were the same, listeners had varying levels of comprehension. Some emperors had no reaction at all while an ancient ancestor’s dao harmonized.

“Boom!” One emperor broke through to the next stage...

Everyone was in a state of zen until they heard his command.

“The lecture ends here, disperse.” Timeflow Lord ordered.

Most knew they wouldn’t live long enough to be present at the next lecture. Therefore, they prostrated to show the highest respect.

“I have a question.” Someone suddenly interrupted.

Everyone was on their knees while a lone man remained standing with a sudden question.

“What?” An ancient ancestor took a look and became confused after seeing a mortal.

How could anyone make it here? The first starting point was the imperial realm.

“Whose clan member is it?” An emperor looked around and said.

However, even an ancient ancestor couldn’t bring someone here through the lord’s ocean of dao mysteries. Carelessness had a potentially fatal outcome.

When Timeflow Lord heard this voice, he stared at the mortal. His gaze alone instilled immense pressure upon the crowd.

“Oh, mommy!” Alas, actually seeing Li Qiye shocked him. He immediately fled for his life to everyone’s astonishment.

They had no idea what was going on? Why did an overlord run at the sight of a mortal?

Li Qiye chuckled and gave chase across the firmaments.

“In a hurry?” Li Qiye appeared before him.

“Immortal, please spare me.” Timeflow accepted the futility of escaping.

“Not running anymore?” Li Qiye smiled.

“No, I dare not, please show mercy.” He begged for forgiveness.

“You haven’t done anything wrong, nor have you offended me, why do you need my mercy?” Li Qiye asked.

Timeflow thought about it and agreed. He heaved a sigh of relief and stood up: “You’re right, Immortal.”

“Or perhaps you did something bad in secret?” Li Qiye stared at him.

“I swear I haven’t done anything wrong, Immortal, just a bit of dao lecture.” He waved repeatedly in response.

“Don’t be so tense, it makes you look guilty.” Li Qiye said.

“Definitely not.” He didn’t know where to place his hands.

“Why are you Timeflow Lord now?” Li Qiye asked.

“Oh, I was Timeflow Lord before.” He assumed his true form - a gelatinous being with stars within.

He was known as Lord of the Stars back in Beastmaster World.

“A lot of identities, I see.” Li Qiye said.

“Immortal, I was Timeflow Lord since Master placed Timeflow Firmament under my jurisdiction. I traveled and stayed in Beastmaster for a bit.” He explained.

“Were you slacking off?” Li Qiye asked.

“No, because everyone here was at a bottleneck, so I let them rest a little.” He said: “Yep, a bit of rest so they can break through later.”

“A good reason to justify your laziness.” Li Qiye smirked.

“Not at all, it was a vacation and I came back occasionally to dao preach.” He spoke without confidence.

His grandmaster was Heaven’s Equal Immortal Monarch. There were many immortals under this banner.

An overlord in a minor world or a firmament was a supreme existence. However, he was neither exceptional nor did he stand out. This was why no one noticed his recent laziness.

“It’s fine, I’m not interested in your business.” Li Qiye waved.

“May I ask why you are here then, Immortal? I will do what I can.” He said.

“I heard you’re aware of some news.” Li Qiye said.

“News? I’m not sure I know what you are talking about.” He shuddered.

“There’s a direct method for me to find out, don’t you know?” Li Qiye said.

“What is it?” He couldn’t help but ask.

“Just remove your mind from your head and take a good look.” Li Qiye said.

“Please don’t...” He turned pale as he said: “I’ll talk, I’ll talk, just don’t do that.”
